Long Haul

入口过渡点

The designated waypoint where an aircraft changes from domestic to oceanic or remote-airspace procedures and communications.

Quick answer: The designated waypoint where an aircraft changes from domestic to oceanic or remote-airspace procedures and communications.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 入口过渡点?

In this glossary, 入口过渡点 refers to: The designated waypoint where an aircraft changes from domestic to oceanic or remote-airspace procedures and communications.

How is 入口过渡点 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Shanwick，ELY123 估计1320 Zulu到达入口过渡点DOGAL，请求洋区放行并确认HF完好。"

Why does 入口过渡点 matter in aviation?

入口过渡点 matters because it supports clear communication in Long Haul contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses 入口过渡点?

入口过渡点 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does 入口过渡点 belong to?

In this glossary, 入口过渡点 is grouped under Long Haul. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

The designated waypoint where an aircraft changes from domestic to oceanic or remote-airspace procedures and communications.

Operational example

Shanwick, ELY123 estimating Entry Transition Point DOGAL at one-three-two-zero Zulu, requesting oceanic clearance and confirming HF readiness.

Localized term

入口过渡点

Localized example

Shanwick，ELY123 估计1320 Zulu到达入口过渡点DOGAL，请求洋区放行并确认HF完好。
